units.source_text: 虽然如此，但六条妃子对世间万般兴事，均有高尚优雅之趣味，自昔以才女著名于世。

en.t: Even so, Lady Rokujo had a refined and elegant taste for every sort of worldly amusement, and from long ago she had been famous as a woman of talent.

units.source_text: 此次斋宫从左卫门府迁居嵯峨野宫，也举办种种饶有风情的兴事。

en.t: On this occasion, when the High Priestess moved from the Left Gate Guards' office to the palace at Sagano, various graceful entertainments were also held there.

units.source_text: 她陪着女儿来到野宫之后，几个风流的殿上公卿不惜冒霜犯露，披星戴月，常到嵯峨野宫附近来遨游。

en.t: After she accompanied her daughter to the temporary shrine in the fields, several elegant courtiers of the palace, undeterred by frost or dew and traveling beneath the stars and moon, often came wandering near the Sagano palace.

units.source_text: 源氏公子闻之，不由想道：“这也难怪。

en.t: When Prince Genji heard of this, he could not help thinking, "That is no wonder.

units.source_text: 妃子多才多艺，品貌十全其美，如果看破红尘，出家修行，当然会寂寞的。”

en.t: The lady is gifted in many arts, and both her character and beauty are perfect; if she were to renounce the world and enter religious practice, of course she would feel lonely."
